integrity.computational_evidence: 36 parameter sets with 72 generator-moment comparisons, 144 tail/bias comparisons and 1044 flux checks; proof analytic
integrity.provenance: Scientific source citations and an exact derivation are included; no authorship or independent certification claimed
integrity.theorem_scope: Fully specified two-state overdamped harmonic stochastic model; derivation and reproducibility provided

limitations: Applies to two regimes, one attractive and one repulsive, with common positive additive Brownian noise and independent switching.
Assumes strictly positive mean stiffness aw>bu; does not treat the nonstationary boundary.
Known earlier results include existence, polynomial-tail classification, and the exponent; the contribution is the exact normalized mixing law, coefficient, and rare-state composition.
Historical priority is provisional and independent review is not performed.
title: Exact beta-mixture variance and rare-event state bias for an intermittently repulsive harmonic particle
